basic.name: Frigid Cold Arrow
basic.description_template: Deals Ice DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of March 7th's ATK to a single enemy.

skill.name: The Power of Cuteness
skill.description_template: Provides a single ally with a Shield that can absorb DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of March 7th's DEF plus {{scaling2}} for 3 turn(s). If the ally's current HP percentage is 30% or higher, greatly increases the chance of enemies attacking that ally.

ultimate.name: Glacial Cascade
ultimate.description_template: Deals Ice DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of March 7th's ATK to all enemies. Hit enemies have a 50% base chance to be Frozen for 1 turn(s). While Frozen, enemies cannot take action and will receive Ice Additional DMG equal to {{scaling2}}% of March 7th's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

talent.name: Girl Power
talent.description_template: After a Shielded ally is attacked by an enemy, March 7th immediately Counters, dealing Ice DMG equal to {{scaling}}% of her ATK. This effect can be triggered 2 time(s) each turn.

technique.name: Freezing Beauty
technique.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, there is a 100% base chance to Freeze a random enemy for 1 turn(s). While Frozen, the enemy cannot take action and will take Ice Additional DMG equal to 50% of March 7th's ATK at the beginning of each turn.

2.name: Purify
2.description: When using Skill, dispels 1 debuff from one designated ally.

4.name: Reinforce
4.description: The duration of the Shield generated from Skill is extended for 1 turn(s).

6.name: Ice Spell
6.description: When using Ultimate, increases the base chance to Freeze enemies by 15%.

eidolons.name: Memory of You
eidolons.description: Every time March 7th's Ultimate Freezes a target, she regenerates 6 Energy.

eidolons.name: Memory of It
eidolons.description: Upon entering battle, grants a Shield equal to 24% of March 7th's DEF plus 320 to the ally with the lowest HP percentage, lasting for 3 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Memory of Everything
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Never Forfeit Again
eidolons.description: The Talent's Counter effect can be triggered 1 more time in each turn. The DMG dealt by Counter increases by an amount that is equal to 30% of March 7th's DEF.

eidolons.name: Never Forget Again
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Just Like This, Always...
eidolons.description: Allies under the protection of the Shield granted by the Skill restore HP equal to 4% of their Max HP plus 106 at the beginning of each turn.
